datasets.title: Guyana: High Resolution Population Density Maps + Demographic Estimates
datasets.description: The world's most accurate population datasets. Seven maps/datasets for the distribution of various populations in Guyana: (1) Overall population density (2) Women (3) Men (4) Children (ages 0-5) (5) Youth (ages 15-24) (6) Elderly (ages 60+) (7) Women of reproductive age (ages 15-49).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/guyana-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates]
datasets.details: To reference this data, please use the following citation: Facebook Connectivity Lab and Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2016. High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL). Source imagery for HRSL © 2016 DigitalGlobe. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.' Please note that as of 2024, Meta's high resolution population density maps are no longer being updated.

lineage.description: Machine learning algorithms identified building footprints from commercial satellite imagery across Guyana. Population estimates derived from publicly available census data and demographic statistics were spatially allocated to these buildings using a methodology developed in partnership with Columbia University, producing gridded population density maps for seven demographic categories at high spatial resolution for the year 2020.

sources.name: Facebook/Meta AI and Data for Good
sources.description: Machine learning-derived building footprints from satellite imagery used as the spatial framework for population distribution modeling

sources.name: Columbia University
sources.description: Population estimation methodology that overlays census data and demographic statistics onto building-level spatial units to generate high-resolution population density maps
